blocker.contract: Both atomic operations must classify a close failure as IO before the atomic commit point and clean up the temporary file.
blocker.exact_gap: Stable std::fs::File has no fallible close method. File::drop closes the descriptor but does not return close errors. File::sync_all is not equivalent: it reports synchronization errors, not a later close error. The allowed implementation also forbids a new unsafe OS boundary, changing accepted sys.rs, and adding an external dependency.
blocker.required_resolution: Coordinator/owner must approve a safe checked-close API boundary or a pinned dependency that exposes checked close, and update the work-order constraints. Until then the required pre-commit IO classification and cleanup cannot be preserved.

legacy_symbol_map.ownership_adaptation: Owned std::fs::File can guarantee descriptor cleanup through Drop but cannot surface close errors; no faithful safe adapter is permitted by this order.
